name: Zucchini
tooltip: Cucurbita pepo. Annual. 18°C+. Can be staked like tomatoes. Beware powdery mildew. Male and female flowers, hand-pollinate or plant with things to attract pollinators. 60Cm apart, 45Cm when staked. Remove leaves below the lowest fruit and sick or damaged leaves. Harvest depends on the variety.

name: Winged beans
tooltip: Psophocarpus tetragonolobus. 15°C+, ideally more. Soak seeds for 24h+, 25-30°C to germinate. Careful with transplant, delicate roots. Climbing vine, needs trellis.

name: Malabar spinach
tooltip: Basella alba. 15°C+. Soak seeds overnight. Keep moist or it will bloom. Leaves turn bitter when blooming. Add compost 1-2x per season. Dry whole fruit for planting. Vining plant, needs a trellis. Harvest when it has 8-10 leaves.

name: Onion
tooltip: Allium cepa. Check which variety is suitable for your area: there’s long-day, short-day and day-neutral. Sowing outdoors possible only in zones 6+.

name: Radish
tooltip: Can be sown repeatedly until the end of summer. 10-15cm spacing. 10°C+, can tolerate lower sunlight

name: Chicory
tooltip: Chicorium. 10°C-23°C. Can be sown repeatedly until early summer and then again in late summer. Hot weather causes it to go to seed.

name: Coriander
tooltip: Coriandrum sativum. 10°C-23°C. Can be sown repeatedly until early summer and then again in late summer. Hot weather causes it to go to seed. Seedlings need more water.
